main_text.l: primum, quantum amphoris omnibus fecium causa de-
cedat, in hunc modum: Amphoris binis decedunt 5 men-
surae: ergo 124 amphoris, decedent 310 mensurae. Mox
enim mensuris amphoram unam definimus) in mensuras
redigo, factus est 3968 mensurae. Ab his 310 mensuras
relinquuntur 3658 mensurae. Unde proportio sic erit:
Hic praecedentes sunt proportiones faciendae, cum
absoluisset opus, Ergo 15 diebus absoluit 1/3 5/0 sive
1/2 operis. Secundus 40 diebus absoluisset totum: ergo
15 diebus absoluit 1/4 5/0 seu 3/8. Additae partes istae
sunt 7/8 operis. Quae ab 8/8 id est toto opere deducta relinquunt

page.notes: Right-hand edge of the facing page is cut off; the fragments there are not transcribed as text. Fractions and the marginal catchword "relinquunt" are reproduced as best legible; the final line is partly cut off by the gutter and may be incomplete.
